0.comment: Mistress of Chenyu Vale: The Flood of the Bishui
0.content: The Mistress of Chenyu Vale raised the Bishui River in a last attempt to defeat Morax, though the water would also have destroyed Chenyu Vale. Fujin, who organized the Rainjade Rite for her lord, threw the Votive Rainjade into the flood from Mt. Lingmeng; the Herblord fought the goddess while Lingyuan led people to shelter. The vale survived. Fujin's own account, in An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade, is the main source.

1.comment: Mistress of Chenyu Vale: The Song of Lament
1.content: Mt. Lingmeng Gossip, Volume 3, says Chenyu Vale songs tell of a demon lord of the distant past who hid in an ancient cave, wearing a skirt of coagulated jade-blood and leaning on a long-destroyed lunar chariot beneath a black pool. The same book names her as the mistress of Chenyu Vale and notes that both indigenous and migrant folk say she began a war from incurable obsession, was defeated, sealed and plunged into dreaming slumber, though the historical details can no longer be verified. A three-line lament is the only supporting evidence.
